_doc: Privacy policy text, rendered by components/legal-document.php. Each entry in 'sections' becomes a numbered clause with its own anchor and a line in the contents list. IMPORTANT: this is starter wording written to be readable, not legal advice - have it reviewed before you rely on it.
title: Privacy Policy
intro: This explains what we do with the details you give us, in plain words. If anything here is unclear, ask and we will explain it properly.

sections.heading: Who we are
text: We are the business named in the footer of this site, and we are the data controller for anything you send us through it.
You can reach a person - not a form queue - using the contact details on the contact page.

sections.heading: What we collect
text: We only ask for what we need to answer you or fulfil an order.
points: Your name, email and phone number when you send an enquiry, book an event or place an order.
The contents of your message, so we can answer it.
Delivery details when you order, kept only as long as the order and its returns window.
Anonymous page counts, if you allowed analytics cookies.

sections.heading: Why we use it
text: To reply to you, to take and deliver an order, and to keep the records the law requires us to keep.
We do not use your details to build a profile of you, and we never sell them.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
text: Enquiries are kept for two years, then deleted. Order records are kept for six years because tax law requires it.
If you ask us to delete something sooner, we will, unless we are legally required to keep it.

sections.heading: Who else sees it
text: Only the suppliers who make the site and the deliveries work.
points: Our web host, who stores the site and its database.
Our email provider, which carries your message to us.
A courier, when a delivery address is needed to reach you.

sections.heading: Cookies
text: Necessary cookies keep the site working and remember your cookie choice itself. Everything else is off until you switch it on.
You can change your mind at any time using the cookie link in the footer.

sections.heading: Your rights
text: You can ask us, at any time and free of charge, to:
points: Tell you what we hold about you.
Delete it, where we are not required to keep it.
Stop using it for marketing - one email is enough.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
text: When this policy changes we update the date at the top. Anything significant is also announced on the site itself.

contact.heading: Questions about your data?
contact.text: Write to us and a person will answer - usually within one working day.
